rubric.evidence: Marked shipped-by-default in Chrome 157 (data-shipped-in="157") verified against live ChromeStatus 5172548013916160, milestone 157 listing, Intent to Ship, BCD (HTMLCanvasElement.json / CanvasRenderingContext2D.json), and Chromium trunk IDLs. Documented API surface changes between the Chrome 148 OT surface shown here and the Chrome 157 shipped surface (content="drawable", void drawElementImage + geometry helpers, texElementSubImage2D, GPUQueue.drawElementImageToTexture) rather than silently rewriting the historical v148 page.
Live conformance suite passes 19/24 (0 fail, 5 manual-evidenced blocked) including browser-support-section and example-surface-present; reference-contract.json is implementation-sufficient.

Page now includes a dedicated #browser-compatibility ('browser support') section with Chrome 148–150 OT status and linked Mozilla (#1076) and WebKit (#630) standards-positions; previous 2026-07-19 browser-support-section failure is resolved.
Single <main>, single <h1>, sequential headings, .warn-block with text heading, and .table-wrap scroll wrappers on all data tables.
Verified in headless Chrome at 1280x800 and 360x740 DPR3: desktop:ok, mobile:ok; zero document overflow (sw=1280/1280, 360/360), zero clipped elements, zero console or network errors.
